# dsh-opencode-go-x-session
中文文档 · English

A host-only DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds
OpenCode Go's required `x-opencode-session` request he

ader to model requests on
the configured OpenCode provider routes — including the requests the offic

ial
auto-review feature builds by hand — and to no other route or host.
## Do you need it?

OpenCode Go / Zen requires every inference request to carry
`x-opencode-session`: a stable identifie

r per conversation, used for routing and
prompt-cache affinity. Since 2026-09-05 requests without it

tion, used for routing and
prompt-cache affinity. Since 2026-09-05 requests without it are rejected:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Install this plugin if you see either of these inside DSH:

- `400 MissingSessionID` on an `opencode-go` / `opencode-go-*` route, or
- `Auto review of tool "...

" failed` when the reviewed session uses an OpenCode Go
route (the reviewer call carries no `session

Id`, so pi-ai's own OpenCode
wrapper has nothing to write).

DSH sends the header natively only on pi-ai catalog requests that carry a
`sessionId`. Auto-review c

alls and hand-declared routes
(`opencode-go-free-none`, `opencode-go-audit-free-none`, custom keys)

lack it.
This plugin fills that gap at the transport layer both paths actually use.
## Requirements
| Requirement | Value |

| DSH | `>= 0.2.1-rc.2` (declared as `dsh.engines.dsh`) |
| Node.js | `>= 22.19.0` |
| Route | an Op
enCode Go provider route (`opencode-go` or `opencode-go-*`) configured with its own `apiKeyEnv` / `b

aseURL` |
| Host | requests go to `opencode.ai` (subdomains included) |
## Install
### Option A — DSH Web UI (recommended)

1. Open DSH → **Plugins** (插件) → **Add plugin** (添加插件).
2. Enter the package name:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

3. Install, then **fully restart DSH**. Bundle layers are composed at startup, so
the plugin does no
t load until DSH restarts.
### Option B — CLI
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Use your own profile name instead of `desktop` if you boot another one. Then
fully restart DSH.
### Option C — from this repository (development)
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Then install the cloned directory as a bundle (Web: Plugins → Install bundle;
agent tool: `install_b

undle` with the directory's absolute path), or install it
as a local link:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

A `link:` installation resolves the plugin's dependencies from its real path, so
run `pnpm install -

-ignore-workspace` in that directory first (it needs
`@deepseek-ai/schemastery`).

Either way the bundle patch inserts one host row, `opencode-session-header`,
into the profile. It ap
plies to every session in that profile.
## Usage
### It works with no configuration

After installation and a restart, requests on `opencode-go` and every
`opencode-go-*` route to `open

code.ai` receive the header automatically. The
value is the DSH session id, so it is stable across t

he turns of one conversation
and distinct between concurrent conversations.

For auto-review, the reviewer request runs inside the reviewed agent's driver
chain, so the plugin r

esolves that conversation's id through
`ctx.agents.currentInitiator()` — the review keeps its prompt

-cache affinity
instead of falling back to a shared id.
### Settings

Settings → Plugins → **OpenCode Session Header**. All fields are optional and
every field is live (`

volatile()`): a settings save applies to the next request
without a restart.
| Field | Default | Meaning |
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch; `false` removes the fetch patch immediately and every request

passes through untouched |
| `providers` | `['opencode-go*']` | Provider routes served by the plugin
; entries may be exact ids or trailing-`*` prefix patterns. The default covers the `opencode-go` cat

alog route and every `opencode-go-*` variant. An empty list disables injection |
| `hosts` | `['open
code.ai']` | Host allowlist; each entry also covers its subdomains. An empty list removes the host c

heck (for a proxy endpoint) |
| `fallbackSessionId` | `dsh-auto-review` | Stable id used only when n

either the request, the enclosing scope, nor an initiator session id exists |
| `debug` | `false` |
Log every injection through the host logger |
### Custom routes and proxy endpoints

- A new `opencode-go-something` route is covered automatically — no config change.
- The plain `open

code` (non-Go) route is **not** covered by the default pattern;
add `opencode` to `providers` if you

use it.
- If your OpenCode endpoint is a proxy with another hostname, either add that
hostname to `

hosts` or set `hosts` to `[]` to disable the host check. The
provider list still scopes injection.
### Check that it is working
1. The DSH startup log shows:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

2. Turn on `debug` and start a conversation on an OpenCode Go route; every
injected request logs:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

3. The original symptom disappears: no more `400 MissingSessionID`, and
[该节后续省略]
## How it works

1. It listens on the supported `llm/stream` waterfall. For a request whose
provider matches `provide

rs`, it resolves the conversation id in this order:
the request's own `sessionId`; the enclosing mod

el-call scope (nested calls);
the initiator agent's session through `ctx.agents.currentInitiator()`

(this is
what gives an auto-review request the conversation it is reviewing); finally
the configured

`fallbackSessionId`. The downstream chunk stream is re-emitted
so every pull runs inside an `AsyncL

ocalStorage` scope carrying that id.
2. It wraps `globalThis.fetch` (the `openai` SDK's default tran

sport). Inside a
captured scope it adds the header when it is absent and the URL host is
allowlisted

; every other request keeps the original arguments. The wrapper is
reference-counted, so HMR reloads

and concurrent activations share one patch,
and it is removed when the last activation unloads.

The plugin changes no model-visible content: no prompt text, no session event,
no transcript entry.
